projects.e2e: full harness exit code verified on both a bad and an approved candidate
projects.failure_recovery: retrieval falls back to dense-only; generation retried once then abstains
projects.security: multi-tenant isolation: cross-tenant retrieval refused (B8B5 PASS)
projects.observability: 7-stage tracer with correlation_id, per-query reliability registry
limitations: ABSTENTION IS MEASURED AND FAILS. The production query() path authorises 8 of 9 labeled no-answer queries, and the no-answer vs answerable score distributions overlap (0.6957 vs 0.3140), so no SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD value separates them. Cosine similarity of the top chunk measures topical similarity, not answerability.

Retrieval recall@3 is 0.4 against a measured oracle ceiling of 0.8, because 17 of 85 answerable questions have no supporting text anywhere in the corpus. Quoting the raw recall as a quality score would be misleading.
This project does not claim to eliminate hallucinations and no test here attempts to.

projects.tests: 150 passed / 1 skipped (the skip needs a VCR cassette or live GROQ key)
projects.failure_recovery: corrupt model -> degraded=True, use_onnx=False (A4 PASS); PLC bridge 7 tests pass once pymodbus is installed
projects.security: api_auth_hardening, db_isolation, db_guard, approval_safety, security_audit suites all in the 150
projects.observability: correlation IDs + structured request logging (HEAD commit)
limitations: A5b FAILS and it is a product defect. src/vision/detector.py:313 returns [] on the quality-reject branch, but infer() documents None as 'no verdict' and [] as 'inspected, no defects found'. A frame rejected for low laplacian variance is therefore reported to the caller as a clean board. In defect inspection that is a false negative: a blank frame or camera fault reads as a part with no defects.
Latency was measured on random-noise frames: P50 43.781ms, P95 81.637ms, P99 174.772ms. That bounds compute cost and says nothing about detection accuracy, which needs labelled frames.
The multi-camera figure is a sequential microbenchmark, so it does not establish behaviour under thread or process contention.

projects.tests: 212 passed / 5 skipped, on a 458,166-row generated dataset
projects.e2e: Raw->Silver->Gold->Mart exercised end to end in the suite
projects.failure_recovery: quarantine DLQ, dedupe, parquet fallback; rerun on identical input is .equals() identical (F1 PASS)
projects.observability: structured JSON log events per ETL stage
limitations: F3 FAILS and it is a defect in the shipped pipeline. Applied directly, apply_contract_gate rejects a malformed record 1/1. In the order the pipeline actually uses, clean_dataframe coerces Target_Qty='abc' to a float NaN while keeping the row; the validator then raises TypeError("'float' object cannot be interpreted as an integer") on that NaN; and because the gate is documented to fail open on validator error, the exception is swallowed, logged as action=failing_open, and the unvalidated row reaches KPI math as a missing quantity.
data/raw/* is gitignored, so the fixture is not in the commit. The 212/212 figure requires running the generator first. A clean clone cannot reproduce it, and a 30-row local stub fails 2 tests.
No Airflow or Spark execution was performed. The DAG file and parity tests are covered, but no scheduler or cluster actually ran.

limitations: 81 of 305 tests cannot run without an Oracle DSN. The guard is working as designed and is a good thing: without it a plain `dotnet test` would write audit rows into a developer's or production Oracle. The cost is that 26% of the suite is unverified in this environment, which is not the same as those tests passing.

FEFO, the idempotency hash and trace-direction parsing are now covered by 21 DB-free tests including input-order stability, quantity being excluded from the sort key, and the field separator preventing two different requests from colliding into one replay.

projects.security: auth-boundary, api-csv injection, XSS escaping, ps1 lint+syntax, 4-shape dynamic-evaluation scan with 0 hits (H7)
limitations: NO BUSINESS CALENDAR. addMinutes (itsm.js:22) is plain wall-clock arithmetic and no business-hours, working-day or holiday helper is exported. A P1 opened Friday 23:00 gets a 15-minute acknowledge target and is breached before anyone is on shift. Every SLA number is 24x7. Recorded as a capability gap rather than a bug, because 24x7 may be the intended policy and the audit cannot tell intent from defect. What it can say is that business-hours SLA support cannot be claimed from here.
No offboarding-workflow test exists, though offboarding appears in 2 other test files.

open_defects.defect: evidence gate authorises 8 of 9 labeled no-answer queries on the production path; no-answer and answerable score distributions overlap so no threshold value separates them
open_defects.fix_direction: a different decision signal (answer-span verification or an NLI entailment check), explicitly NOT threshold tuning
open_defects.severity: high for a system whose value proposition is grounded answers

open_defects.defect: quality-rejected frames return [] which infer() defines as a clean board, so a camera fault reads as a defect-free part
open_defects.fix_direction: return None (no verdict) on the quality-reject branch
open_defects.severity: high: false negative in defect inspection

open_defects.defect: clean_dataframe produces NaN that makes the contract validator raise, and the gate fails open, so malformed rows reach KPI math
open_defects.fix_direction: either stop producing the NaN or treat NaN as a violation instead of letting the validator raise
open_defects.severity: high: a silent numeric gap in a production ledger

honest_limits: enterprise_score is null for every project. A single score across a vision system, an ETL pipeline and an ERP would hide exactly the differences that matter, and no rubric was agreed before the data was collected.
Four of seven projects have no Azure deployment. The Azure column is NOT_RUN for them rather than assumed.
No project in this matrix is claimed to be production-ready. Each row's limitations are the operative statement about that project.
